'''Ubrikkian Ord Pedrova''' was a subsidiary of [[Ubrikkian Industries/Legends|Ubrikkian Industries]] that manufactured vehicles such as the [[WLO-5 speeder tank/Legends|WLO-5 speeder tank]], a [[Repulsorcraft/Legends|repulsorcraft]] [[Speeder/Legends|speeder]] [[Tank/Legends|tank]] used prominently by criminal organizations such as the [[Ohnaka Gang/Legends|Ohnaka Gang]].<ref name="TCWIV" /> An earlier entry in the WLO-series was in use during the [[Third Galactic War]], known as the [[WL0-RX1 Assault Tank]].
